title: Analysis code for area per lipid and area compressibility modulus (KA) of mixed lipid bilayers from MD simulations
description: Analysis scripts used to compute area per lipid (APL) and area compressibility modulus (KA) from all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of mixed lipid bilayers, and to compare mixed systems against pure bilayers by two-sample t-tests. Each tagged release is archived on Zenodo.
